findings: Reviewed f4_terminal plus actual STATE declaration, one-shot CAS and Acquire observers. MOVB immediate3 at0x26e9d6 is nontearing on x86 normal kernel memory. Release suitability comes from BOTH default read/write asm memory effects (no nomem/readonly/pure) and x86 store ordering, not nontearing alone. MOV leaves flags and registers intact as promised by preserves_flags/nostack. as_ptr emits only moves/stack adjustment/RET, no dispatcher.
